create.name: Bella Miles
create.bio:
Bella Miles is an Australian yoga and meditation teacher who lives and teaches in Copenhagen, in English. She took up yoga in her late teens and went on to train with the Australian Yoga Academy, completing an advanced diploma in yoga teaching and a separate meditation teacher training, then adding trauma-sensitive yoga, the Shake the Dust movement method of Satu Tuomela and an embodied yoga therapy certificate from Embodied Philosophy.

Her classes blend flowing asana with somatic exercises, pranayama, meditation and elements of Tai Chi and Qi Gong, and she frames the practice around three words: connection, compassion and contentment. She teaches regular classes at several Copenhagen studios and offers one-to-one sessions, in person or online, for people who want help shaping a personal practice. Her small day and weekend retreats in the Danish countryside pair yin yoga, meditation and journaling with shared meals and time outdoors, and she runs a four-week online meditation course, The Space In-Between, that ranges across the philosophy, science and practice of sitting. She also brings yoga to workplaces and teams, and shares free guided meditations and breath practices on Insight Timer and YouTube.

courses.title: Winter Day Retreat
courses.description: A one-day retreat at a cabin in the woods near Svebølle, about an hour from Copenhagen, led with Sarah, who cooks. The day brings together a long brunch, yin yoga, somatic practice, journaling and meditation, with time by the fire or in nature.

courses.title: 1:1 Yogic Guide
courses.description: Private sessions online or in Copenhagen, either single sessions or a programme of four, eight or twelve weeks with recordings and written material. Sessions are shaped around the person's own practice, from meditation and pranayama to movement and self-compassion.
courses.price: 800 DKK (60 min), 1,100 DKK (90 min); 4, 8 or 12-week programmes from 3,200 DKK

courses.title: Company and Group Yoga
courses.description: Yoga, breath and meditation sessions for workplaces, sports teams and community groups, from a single workshop to a six-week series or a half-day retreat. Sessions are tailored to the group and its schedule.

free_resources.title: Soft Presence And Quiet Awareness - 15 Minute Meditation
free_resources.description: A quarter-hour sitting practice that rests attention on breath and body and opens into a quieter, wider awareness. Free on Insight Timer.

free_resources.title: Yoga Nidra For Deep Rest
free_resources.description: A thirteen-minute yoga nidra, lying down, moving through the body and breath into stillness. Free on Insight Timer.
